findings.description: F-014: «-20 по ширине и высоте убирает примерно по 10 пикселей с каждой стороны» (build_chapter_20.py:1705-1711) -- for even arguments inflate() is exact, not approximate: measured 64 -> 44 with the centre preserved, i.e. exactly 10 px per side. The hedge taught distrust of a deterministic API. The same sentence also ended on an unanchored gerund («а не 20 — подобрав нужный отступ на глаз»).
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_20.py: «примерно» -> «ровно», and the trailing gerund was split into its own sentence — «Конкретный отступ подбирают на глаз под каждый спрайт.» Verified after rebuild: «примерно по 10» returns 0 files and «убирает ровно по 10» returns 1.

evidence.summary: Learning objective and scope: Teaches `Rect.colliderect()`, opens it up as a four-comparison AABB test, and distinguishes the hitbox from the drawn artwork.

`colliderect()` is an axis-aligned bounding-box test equivalent to the chapter's four comparisons. -- Confirmed -- the hand-written function agrees with pygame.Rect.colliderect on all six cases tried, including edge-touching (both False), 1px overlap (both True), zero-width (both False) and corner-adjacent (both False).
Two rectangles fail to intersect exactly when one is entirely left, right, above or below the other. -- Confirmed -- a correct statement of the separating-axis argument for the AABB case.

`rect.inflate(-20, -20)` shrinks the total size while preserving the centre, removing ~10 px per side. -- Confirmed on the mechanism, imprecise on the hedge -- Rect(68,68,64,64).inflate(-20,-20) gives Rect(78,78,44,44) with the centre unchanged: exactly 10 px per side. Fixed under F-014.
Taking the hitbox from the full image size, transparent padding included, makes hits feel unfair. -- Confirmed -- correct and standard game-feel reasoning, illustrated by a real two-rectangle figure.
